verses.text: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.

segments.text: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart,
There is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, That his iniquity will not be found out and be hated.

segments.text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes,
That his iniquity will not be found out and be hated.

verses.text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath ceased to be wise and to do good.

segments.text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit:
He hath ceased to be wise
and
to do good.

verses.text: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.

segments.text: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed;
He setteth himself in a way that is not good;
He abhorreth not evil.

verses.text: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness reacheth unto the skies.

segments.text: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens;
Thy faithfulness
reacheth
unto the skies.

verses.text: Thy righteousness is like the mountains of God; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Jehovah, thou preservest man and beast.

segments.text: Thy righteousness is like the mountains of God;
Thy judgments are a great deep:
O Jehovah, thou preservest man and beast.

verses.text: How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.

segments.text: How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God!
And the children of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.

verses.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

segments.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house;
And thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

verses.text: For with thee is the fountain of life: In thy light shall we see light.

segments.text: For with thee is the fountain of life:
In thy light shall we see light.

verses.text: Oh continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee, And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

segments.text: Oh continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee,
And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

segments.text: Let not the foot of pride come against me,
And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

verses.text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

segments.text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen:
They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David the servant of Jehovah.
